# GemGame: Cozy Match 3 Puzzle

> A free match-3 puzzle for iPhone: no ads, offline core puzzles and a magical garden to restore. Campaign lives refill over time; purchases are optional.

English-language game for iPhone with iOS 18 or later. Public version checked 12 September 2026: 2.3.0. Match adjacent jewels, create special combinations and spend earned stars on garden restoration. Daily Star offers a free daily board with no life cost. Jewel Lab is free practice with no lives spent or campaign rewards earned. Complete Collection is one optional permanent purchase containing five premium chapter reward tracks and 50 Hard Mode puzzles. Coin packs are separate. Some decorative finishes require premium access. Purchases, Restore Purchases and Game Center require internet. Progress is stored locally; purchase restoration is not campaign-save recovery.
